name: process
description: A process individual links participants via obo:RO_0000057, realizes one or more roles via obo:BFO_0000055, and is bounded in time by obo:BFO_0000199 (occupies temporal region). This is the join point between the agent, role and temporal patterns.
competency_questions: Which processes are recorded in the knowledge graph, and who participates in them?; Which role is realised in a given process, and over which period?
